THE RESTORATION / 1968 CHEVROLET CORVAIR

Not an overnight fix.
A story in the making.

From first inspection to the first drive. Follow the questions, discoveries, and small wins along the way.

Explore the roadmap ↓
THE ROAD AHEAD

Piece by piece.

This is our planned route through the restoration. Stages can overlap. Completed work will be documented in the journal.

01
PLANNED MILESTONE

Before the first turn
of a wrench.

Capture the car as it is. Photograph the body, cabin, and mechanical areas, gather its known history, and record what we still need to learn.

  • Starting-condition photography
  • Known history and missing information
  • Initial restoration goals
How we’ll document the build ↗
02
PLANNED MILESTONE

Look closely.
Ask better questions.

Work with experienced people to understand the car’s condition. Turn observations into a realistic scope of work before deciding what comes apart.

  • Record findings by system
  • Identify questions for experienced mentors
  • Prioritize the work ahead
Get familiar with the systems ↗
03
PLANNED MILESTONE

Take it apart.
Keep the story together.

Document each area as work begins. Organize parts and photographs so that the record remains useful when it’s time to put things back together.

  • Photograph before and during removal
  • Label and organize removed parts
  • Record discoveries and decisions
Explore the model’s assemblies ↗
04
PLANNED MILESTONE

Understand the machine.
Then do the work.

Document mechanical work as its scope becomes clear: the problems we find, the advice we receive, and the reasoning behind each repair.

  • Engine and drivetrain observations
  • Steering, suspension, and braking work
  • Repair decisions and lessons learned
Explore the engine assembly ↗
05
PLANNED MILESTONE

The details
make it ours.

Assess the body and cabin, document the work they need, and make thoughtful choices about what to preserve, repair, or replace.

  • Body condition and repair planning
  • Cabin materials and fittings
  • Before-and-after comparisons
Explore body components ↗
06
PLANNED MILESTONE

Everything finds
its place.

Bring the work together, checking the restoration record as assemblies return to the car. Document fit, outstanding questions, and follow-up work.

  • Use the photographed parts record
  • Check completed work with mentors
  • Track remaining tasks
Why the record matters ↗
07
PLANNED MILESTONE

Check. Learn.
Check again.

Work with qualified help to evaluate the completed work and resolve issues before road use. Record results and the changes they lead to.

  • Document professional checks
  • Resolve outstanding faults
  • Record results and next steps
Share your experience ↗
08
THE LONG-TERM GOAL

Back on the road.
On to the next story.

The goal that connects every small job: seeing the Corvair on the road again and sharing what the journey taught us.

  • Celebrate the people behind the work
  • Share the restoration story
  • Keep learning and documenting
The vision beyond one car ↗

The record starts here.

Hands-on restoration updates will appear here as they’re published. For now, get to know the project and our approach.
